limitations: All seven late tests observe a midpoint; an earlier negative proves only its tested branch, not level-wide absence.
First visible falling entry poses after earlier deaths are not initial spawn coordinates. Underground/water respawns before a midpoint bypass the outdoor start scene.
Three-two artwork repeats, so an isolated nearest static-map match is insufficient; follow-through evidence resolves its camera.
No runtime activation rules or production files are changed by this inventory.
These are checkpoint mechanic experiments, not ordered campaign wins.
